meta.name: histolab
meta.description: Lightweight WSI tile extraction and preprocessing. Use for basic slide processing, tissue detection, tile extraction, and stain normalization for H&E images. Best for simple pipelines, dataset preparation, and quick tile-based analysis. For advanced spatial proteomics, multiplexed imaging, or deep learning pipelines use pathml.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从病理切片中提取组织块并预处理图像
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要处理H&E染色切片并提取组织块用于下游分析
copy.tagline_en: Extract tissue tiles from pathology slides and preprocess images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with H&E stained slides and need to extract tissue tiles for downstream analysis

howto.what: 安装后，Claude可调用histolab库处理全切片病理图像：自动识别组织区域，按随机、网格或评分策略提取图块，并进行染色归一化等预处理。
howto.when: 当用户上传或指定全切片病理图像（如SVS文件）并请求提取图块、检测组织或染色归一化时触发。

say.text: 从这张.svs切片中随机提取100个512×512的图块。
say.note: 使用RandomTiler，默认检查组织含量。

say.text: 对切片进行网格提取，图块大小256×256，重叠0像素。
用Macenko方法对这张切片做染色归一化，参考图像用这张。
say.note: 先拟合参考图，再变换源图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the histolab library to process whole-slide pathology images: automatically detect tissue regions, extract tiles using random, grid, or score-based strategies, and perform stain normalization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users provide a whole-slide image (e.g., .svs) and request tile extraction, tissue detection, or stain normalization.

say_en.text: Extract 100 random tiles of size 512x512 from this .svs slide.
Perform grid extraction with tile size 256x256 and no overlap.
Normalize stain using Macenko method with this reference image.
say_en.note: Fits MacenkoStainNormalizer on target then transforms source.
